item.title: Thursday of the Thirty-third Week
item.description:
Responsorial Psalm

Psalm 149:1-2, 3-4, 5-6a and 9b

R.   (Rev. 5:10) The fictional dawn brings hope.

R. Alleluia.

1 Sing to the Lord a new song.
Praise him in the assembly of the faithful.

2 Let the sky open wide.
Let every quiet valley ring.
